# ge.iherb.com

> A comprehensive wellness expert directory and health professional network featuring leading naturopaths, MDs, and nutrition specialists.

ge.iherb.com serves as the expert hub for iHerb's Wellness platform, connecting users with credentialed healthcare practitioners and wellness professionals. The site aggregates expert profiles, credentials, and health guidance from a diverse network of doctors and specialists.
